tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Eight US states are suing OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT causes harm to children. Reported by NZ Herald.
Large language models can control robots but remain 100 times slower and 10 times costlier than humans, according to a new evaluation leaderboard. Reported by 36Kr.
Law firms should think carefully before pursuing spin-offs built on artificial intelligence technology. Reported by Financial Times.
DeepSeek has apologized for a service outage and announced a compensation plan that includes a full refund of bonuses. Reported by 中华网.
Harmonic Security raised 50 million dollars to expand its platform for governing how employees use artificial intelligence tools in enterprises. Reported by SC Media.
Free every hour.
